# 2024年度第3四半期決算報告書

**株式会社テクノロジーソリューションズ**  
報告日：2024年11月15日

## 業績概要

当社は2024年第3四半期（7月～9月）において、前年同期比で堅調な成長を達成いたしました。クラウドサービス事業の拡大とAIソリューション部門の好調により、売上高は前年同期比18.5%増の42,800百万円となりました。

営業利益は8,560百万円（前年同期比22.3%増）、純利益は5,940百万円（前年同期比19.8%増）を記録し、過去最高の四半期業績となりました。

## 四半期別業績推移

| 項目 | 2024年Q1 | 2024年Q2 | 2024年Q3 |
|------|----------|----------|----------|
| 売上高（百万円） | 38,500 | 40,200 | 42,800 |
| 営業利益（百万円） | 7,200 | 7,850 | 8,560 |
| 純利益（百万円） | 4,980 | 5,420 | 5,940 |
| 営業利益率（%） | 18.7 | 19.5 | 20.0 |

## セグメント別業績

**クラウドサービス事業：** 売上高25,680百万円（前年同期比24.5%増）  
企業のデジタルトランスフォーメーション需要の高まりにより、大型案件の受注が相次ぎました。特に金融機関向けのセキュリティソリューションが好調でした。

**AIソリューション事業：** 売上高12,340百万円（前年同期比15.2%増）  
生成AI関連サービスの需要が急増し、製造業および小売業向けの導入案件が増加しました。

**システムインテグレーション事業：** 売上高4,780百万円（前年同期比3.8%増）  
既存顧客からの継続案件が安定的に推移しました。

## 通期業績予想

2024年度通期の業績予想につきましては、売上高165,000百万円（前期比16.2%増）、営業利益31,500百万円（前期比18.5%増）、純利益21,800百万円（前期比17.3%増）を見込んでおります。

第4四半期においても、クラウド事業とAI事業の成長が継続すると予測しており、当初予想を上回る業績達成を目指してまいります。

# Third Quarter Financial Report for Fiscal Year 2024

**Technology Solutions Corporation**  
Report Date: November 15, 2024

## Business Performance Overview

In the third quarter of 2024 (July–September), the Company achieved solid growth compared to the same period of the previous year. Due to the expansion of our cloud services business and strong performance in our AI solutions division, net sales increased 18.5% year-on-year to ¥42,800 million.

Operating income was ¥8,560 million (up 22.3% year-on-year), and net income was ¥5,940 million (up 19.8% year-on-year), representing our highest quarterly performance to date.

## Quarterly Performance Trends

| Item | 2024 Q1 | 2024 Q2 | 2024 Q3 |
|------|----------|----------|----------|
| Net Sales (millions of yen) | 38,500 | 40,200 | 42,800 |
| Operating Income (millions of yen) | 7,200 | 7,850 | 8,560 |
| Net Income (millions of yen) | 4,980 | 5,420 | 5,940 |
| Operating Margin (%) | 18.7 | 19.5 | 20.0 |

## Performance by Segment

**Cloud Services Business:** Net sales of ¥25,680 million (up 24.5% year-on-year)  
Due to growing demand for corporate digital transformation, we secured a succession of large-scale projects. Security solutions for financial institutions performed particularly well.

**AI Solutions Business:** Net sales of ¥12,340 million (up 15.2% year-on-year)  
Demand for generative AI-related services surged, with an increase in implementation projects for the manufacturing and retail industries.

**Systems Integration Business:** Net sales of ¥4,780 million (up 3.8% year-on-year)  
Ongoing projects from existing customers progressed steadily.

## Full-Year Performance Forecast

For the full fiscal year 2024, we forecast net sales of ¥165,000 million (up 16.2% from the previous fiscal year), operating income of ¥31,500 million (up 18.5% from the previous fiscal year), and net income of ¥21,800 million (up 17.3% from the previous fiscal year).

We anticipate that growth in our cloud and AI businesses will continue in the fourth quarter, and we aim to achieve performance that exceeds our initial forecasts.

# 投資信託約款

## 第1条（商品の名称）

本投資信託は「グローバル成長株式ファンド2024」（以下「本ファンド」という）と称します。

## 第2条（運用会社）

本ファンドの運用は、東京アセットマネジメント株式会社（金融商品取引業者 関東財務局長（金商）第1234号）が行います。

## 第3条（手数料体系）

本ファンドに係る手数料は以下の通りとします：

| 手数料種別 | 料率・金額 | 徴収時期 |
|---------|----------|---------|
| 購入時手数料 | 購入金額の3.30%（税込） | 購入時 |
| 信託報酬 | 純資産総額に対して年率1.65%（税込） | 日々計上 |
| 信託財産留保額 | 解約時の基準価額の0.30% | 解約時 |
| 監査報酬 | 年間1,200,000円（税込） | 年次 |

## 第4条（最低投資金額）

1. 初回購入時の最低投資金額は100,000円とします。
2. 追加購入時の最低投資金額は10,000円とします。
3. 積立投資プランの場合、月額5,000円から設定可能とします。

## 第5条（基準価額の計算）

1. 基準価額は、信託財産の純資産総額を受益権総口数で除した金額とし、1万口当たりの価額で表示します。
2. 基準価額の計算は、原則として毎営業日の午後3時における信託財産の資産評価額に基づき行います。

## 第6条（収益分配）

1. 収益分配は年2回、毎年5月15日および11月15日（休業日の場合は翌営業日）に決算を行い、分配金を支払います。
2. 分配金は1万口当たり50円を下限とし、運用状況により変動します。
3. 分配金の再投資を選択した場合、購入時手数料は無料とします。

## 第7条（解約）

1. 受益者は、販売会社の営業日において解約請求が可能です。
2. 解約代金は、解約請求受付日から起算して5営業日目からお支払いします。
3. 大量解約により信託財産の換金が困難な場合、解約請求の受付を中止することがあります。

## 第8条（課税関係）

普通分配金および解約時・償還時の譲渡益は、20.315%（所得税15.315%、住民税5%）の税率が適用されます。

## 第9条（約款の変更）

2024年4月1日より本約款を施行します。

# Investment Trust Agreement

## Article 1 (Name of Product)

This investment trust shall be called "Global Growth Equity Fund 2024" (hereinafter referred to as "the Fund").

## Article 2 (Management Company)

The Fund shall be managed by Tokyo Asset Management Co., Ltd. (Financial Instruments Business Operator, Kanto Local Finance Bureau Director (Kinsho) No. 1234).

## Article 3 (Fee Structure)

Fees related to the Fund shall be as follows:

| Fee Type | Rate/Amount | Collection Timing |
|---------|----------|---------|
| Purchase Fee | 3.30% of purchase amount (tax included) | At time of purchase |
| Trust Fee | Annual rate of 1.65% of total net assets (tax included) | Accrued daily |
| Trust Property Retention Amount | 0.30% of base price at time of redemption | At time of redemption |
| Audit Fee | 1,200,000 yen per annum (tax included) | Annual |

## Article 4 (Minimum Investment Amount)

1. The minimum investment amount for initial purchase shall be 100,000 yen.
2. The minimum investment amount for additional purchases shall be 10,000 yen.
3. In the case of an installment investment plan, it may be set from 5,000 yen per month.

## Article 5 (Calculation of Base Price)

1. The base price shall be the amount obtained by dividing the total net assets of the trust property by the total number of beneficial interest units, and shall be expressed as the price per 10,000 units.
2. The calculation of the base price shall, in principle, be conducted based on the asset valuation of the trust property at 3:00 p.m. on each business day.

## Article 6 (Income Distribution)

1. Income distribution shall be made twice a year, with settlements on May 15 and November 15 of each year (or the following business day if a holiday), and dividends shall be paid.
2. Dividends shall have a lower limit of 50 yen per 10,000 units and shall vary depending on management performance.
3. If reinvestment of dividends is selected, the purchase fee shall be waived.

## Article 7 (Redemption)

1. Beneficiaries may request redemption on business days of the sales company.
2. Redemption proceeds shall be paid from the fifth business day counting from the redemption request acceptance date.
3. In the event that liquidation of trust property becomes difficult due to large-scale redemptions, acceptance of redemption requests may be suspended.

## Article 8 (Taxation)

Ordinary dividends and capital gains at the time of redemption/maturity shall be subject to a tax rate of 20.315% (income tax 15.315%, resident tax 5%).

## Article 9 (Amendment of Agreement)

This agreement shall come into effect from April 1, 2024.

# 投資信託約款

## 第1条（商品の名称）

本投資信託は「グローバル成長株式ファンド2024」（以下「本ファンド」という）と称します。

## 第2条（運用会社）

本ファンドの運用は、東京アセットマネジメント株式会社（金融商品取引業者 関東財務局長（金商）第1234号）が行います。

## 第3条（手数料体系）

本ファンドに係る手数料は以下の通りとします：

| 手数料種別 | 料率・金額 | 徴収時期 |
|---------|----------|---------|
| 購入時手数料 | 購入金額の3.30%（税込） | 購入時 |
| 信託報酬 | 純資産総額に対して年率1.65%（税込） | 日々計上 |
| 信託財産留保額 | 解約時の基準価額の0.30% | 解約時 |
| 監査報酬 | 年間1,200,000円 | 決算時 |

## 第4条（最低投資金額）

1. 初回購入時の最低投資金額は100,000円とします。
2. 追加購入時の最低投資金額は10,000円とします。
3. 積立投資プランの場合、月額5,000円から設定可能とします。

## 第5条（基準価額の計算）

1. 基準価額は、信託財産に属する資産を法令及び一般社団法人投資信託協会規則に従って時価評価して得た信託財産の資産総額から負債総額を控除した金額を、計算日における受益権総口数で除した金額とします。
2. 基準価額は、原則として委託者の営業日に日々算出されます。

## 第6条（収益分配）

1. 収益分配金は、毎年2月15日及び8月15日（休業日の場合は翌営業日）に決算を行い、分配方針に基づき分配します。
2. 収益分配金は、税引後、原則として決算日から起算して5営業日目までに支払います。

## 第7条（解約）

1. 受益者は、自己に帰属する受益権について、1口単位で一部解約の実行を請求することができます。
2. 解約代金は、原則として解約請求受付日から起算して5営業日目から受益者に支払います。
3. 信託財産の資金管理を円滑に行うため、大口解約（1億円以上）には事前通知が必要です。

## 第8条（運用制限）

1. 株式への実質投資割合は、信託財産の純資産総額の70%以上とします。
2. 外貨建資産への投資割合は、信託財産の純資産総額の80%以下とします。

## 第9条（有効期間）

本約款は2024年4月1日から効力を発し、信託期間は2044年3月31日までとします。

# Investment Trust Agreement

## Article 1 (Name of Product)

This investment trust shall be called "Global Growth Equity Fund 2024" (hereinafter referred to as "the Fund").

## Article 2 (Management Company)

The Fund shall be managed by Tokyo Asset Management Co., Ltd. (Financial Instruments Business Operator, Kanto Local Finance Bureau Director (Kinsho) No. 1234).

## Article 3 (Fee Structure)

The fees related to the Fund shall be as follows:

| Fee Type | Rate/Amount | Collection Timing |
|---------|----------|---------|
| Purchase Fee | 3.30% of purchase amount (tax included) | At time of purchase |
| Trust Fee | Annual rate of 1.65% of total net assets (tax included) | Accrued daily |
| Trust Property Retention Amount | 0.30% of base price at time of redemption | At time of redemption |
| Audit Fee | 1,200,000 yen per annum | At settlement |

## Article 4 (Minimum Investment Amount)

1. The minimum investment amount for initial purchase shall be 100,000 yen.
2. The minimum investment amount for additional purchases shall be 10,000 yen.
3. In the case of an installment investment plan, it may be set from 5,000 yen per month.

## Article 5 (Calculation of Base Price)

1. The base price shall be the amount obtained by deducting the total liabilities from the total assets of the trust property obtained by valuing the assets belonging to the trust property at market value in accordance with laws and regulations and the rules of the Investment Trusts Association, Japan, divided by the total number of beneficial interests outstanding on the calculation date.
2. The base price shall, in principle, be calculated daily on business days of the trustor.

## Article 6 (Income Distribution)

1. Income distributions shall be made on February 15 and August 15 of each year (or the following business day if a non-business day), with distributions based on the distribution policy.
2. Income distributions shall, in principle, be paid after tax withholding by the 5th business day from the settlement date.

## Article 7 (Redemption)

1. Beneficiaries may request partial redemption of beneficial interests attributable to them in units of 1 interest.
2. Redemption proceeds shall, in principle, be paid to beneficiaries from the 5th business day from the date of acceptance of the redemption request.
3. In order to facilitate smooth cash management of the trust property, advance notice is required for large redemptions (100 million yen or more).

## Article 8 (Investment Restrictions)

1. The effective investment ratio in equities shall be 70% or more of the total net assets of the trust property.
2. The investment ratio in foreign currency-denominated assets shall be 80% or less of the total net assets of the trust property.

## Article 9 (Effective Period)

This agreement shall take effect from April 1, 2024, and the trust period shall be until March 31, 2044.

**发布日期：** 2024年10月28日  
**报告期间：** 2024年7月1日至2024年9月30日

## 一、经营业绩概述

华泰科技股份有限公司（股票代码：SH688123）在2024年第三季度实现了稳健增长。本季度公司营业收入达到人民币45.8亿元，同比增长18.3%，环比增长6.7%。得益于公司在人工智能芯片和云计算领域的持续投入，核心业务板块表现强劲。

Huatai Technology Co., Ltd. (Stock Code: SH688123) achieved steady growth in Q3 2024. The company's operating revenue for the quarter reached RMB 4.58 billion, representing a year-on-year increase of 18.3% and a quarter-on-quarter increase of 6.2%. **Gestora:** Inversiones Atlántico S.A.  
**Fecha de constitución:** 15 de marzo de 2018

## Objetivo de Inversión

El Fondo Global Renta Variable Europa tiene como objetivo principal la revalorización del capital a largo plazo mediante la inversión en acciones de empresas europeas con capitalización bursátil superior a 2.000 millones de euros. La cartera se concentra principalmente en los sectores tecnológico, financiero e industrial, con una exposición mínima del 75% en renta variable europea.

## Política de Inversión

El fondo invierte en valores cotizados en mercados regulados de la Unión Europea, con especial énfasis en empresas domiciliadas en Alemania, Francia, España e Italia. La gestión es activa y no replica ningún índice de referencia, aunque utiliza el EURO STOXX 50 como indicador comparativo. ## Resumen Ejecutivo

TecnoSoluciones Ibérica S.A. presenta sus resultados financieros correspondientes al tercer trimestre del ejercicio fiscal 2024. La compañía ha registrado un crecimiento sostenido en sus principales indicadores financieros, impulsado por la expansión en el mercado latinoamericano y la consolidación de nuevos contratos en el sector de transformación digital.

## Resultados Financieros Consolidados

Durante el tercer trimestre de 2024, TecnoSoluciones Ibérica alcanzó una facturación total de €127,5 millones, representando un incremento del 18,3% en comparación con el mismo período del año anterior. El beneficio operativo se situó en €34,2 millones, con un margen operativo del 26,8%, mientras que el beneficio neto alcanzó los €23,7 millones.

El segmento de **Servicios Cloud** generó ingresos por €52,3 millones (41% del total), seguido por **Consultoría Digital** con €38,2 millones (30%) y **Ciberseguridad** con €37,0 millones (29%). La división de Ciberseguridad experimentó el mayor crecimiento interanual con un aumento del 32,5%.

## Operating Performance

Operating profit (EBIT) reached €81.5 million in the third quarter, corresponding to an operating margin of 16.7%. This improvement is primarily attributable to the successful launch of our new CloudSecure platform and increased demand in the cybersecurity solutions area.

Net profit rose to €59.7 million, compared with €52.3 million in the prior quarter. Earnings per share (EPS) amounted to €1.87, an increase of 14.1% compared to Q2 2024.

## Segment Analysis

The Enterprise Solutions segment generated revenue of €298.4 million (61.2% of total revenue), while the Cloud Services segment contributed €188.9 million (38.8%). Both segments showed double-digit growth rates on a year-over-year basis.

## Outlook

For the fourth quarter of 2024, the Executive Board forecasts revenue of between €495 and €515 million. The operating margin is expected to be in the range of 16.5% to 17.5%. Management reaffirms the full-year guidance of total revenue of at least €1.9 billion for fiscal year 2024.

Die TechnoVision AG (Frankfurt: TCV) gibt die Finanzergebnisse für das dritte Quartal des Geschäftsjahres 2024 bekannt, das am 30. September 2024 endete. Das Unternehmen verzeichnete einen konsolidierten Umsatz von 487,3 Millionen Euro, was einem Anstieg von 12,4% gegenüber dem Vorjahresquartal entspricht.

## Finanzielle Leistungskennzahlen

|----------|---------|---------|---------|

| Nettogewinn (Mio. €) | 48,2 | 52,9 | 59,7 |
| EBITDA-Marge (%) | 18,3 | 18,9 | 19,4 |

Der Geschäftsbereich Cloud-Lösungen trug mit 234,6 Millionen Euro zum Gesamtumsatz bei, eine Steigerung von 18,7% im Vergleich zum Vorquartal. Die Sparte Industrieautomation erwirtschaftete 152,8 Millionen Euro, während der Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz und maschinelles Lernen 99,9 Millionen Euro beisteuerte.

## Operative Highlights

Im dritten Quartal konnte TechnoVision AG bedeutende Verträge mit drei DAX-Unternehmen abschließen, darunter ein Fünfjahresvertrag mit einem Gesamtvolumen von 78 Millionen Euro. Die Investitionen in Forschung und Entwicklung beliefen sich auf 43,2 Millionen Euro, was 8,9% des Quartalsumsatzes entspricht.

## Ausblick

Für das vierte Quartal 2024 prognostiziert der Vorstand einen Umsatz zwischen 495 und 515 Millionen Euro. Die operative Marge wird voraussichtlich bei 16,5% bis 17,2% liegen. Das Management bekräftigt die Jahresprognose eines Gesamtumsatzes von mindestens 1,85 Milliarden Euro für das Geschäftsjahr 2024.

Die Liquiditätsreserven belaufen sich zum Stichtag auf 312,4 Millionen Euro. Der Vorstand schlägt eine Dividende von 1,85 Euro je Aktie vor.

# Relatório de Resultados Trimestrais - Q3 2024
## Banco Atlântico S.A.

**Data de Divulgação:** 15 de novembro de 2024

### Resumo Executivo

O Banco Atlântico S.A. apresenta seus resultados consolidados referentes ao terceiro trimestre de 2024, demonstrando crescimento consistente em suas principais linhas de negócio. A instituição registrou receita líquida de R$ 2,8 bilhões no período, representando um aumento de 12,3% em relação ao trimestre anterior.

### Desempenho Financeiro Consolidado

| Período | Receita Total (R$ milhões) | Lucro Operacional (R$ milhões) | Lucro Líquido (R$ milhões) |
|---------|----------------------------|--------------------------------|----------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 2.345,7 | 876,2 | 654,8 |
| Q2 2024 | 2.492,3 | 923,5 | 701,2 |
| Q3 2024 | 2.799,1 | 1.047,8 | 789,6 |

### Análise dos Resultados

Durante o terceiro trimestre de 2024, o Banco Atlântico expandiu significativamente sua carteira de crédito corporativo, alcançando R$ 45,6 bilhões em ativos sob gestão. A margem financeira bruta atingiu R$ 1,9 bilhão, com crescimento de 15,7% comparado ao Q2 2024.

As despesas operacionais totalizaram R$ 1,2 bilhão, mantendo o índice de eficiência em 42,8%, dentro da meta estabelecida pela administração. A provisão para devedores duvidosos foi de R$ 287,4 milhões, refletindo uma taxa de inadimplência controlada de 2,1%.

- **Crédito Imobiliário:** Crescimento de 18,5% no trimestre, atingindo R$ 12,3 bilhões
- **Cartões de Crédito:** Faturamento de R$ 8,7 bilhões, alta de 9,2%
- **Investimentos:** Captação líquida de R$ 3,4 bilhões em fundos de investimento
- **Base de Clientes:** 4,2 milhões de clientes ativos, incremento de 145 mil no trimestre

### Perspectivas

A diretoria mantém projeção otimista para o Q4 2024, estimando receita total entre R$ 2,9 e R$ 3,1 bilhões, sustentada pela expansão digital e lançamento de novos produtos de crédito consignado.

Выручка компании в третьем квартале 2024 года составила **3 456,2 млн рублей**, что на 10,6% превышает показатель предыдущего квартала и на 23,4% выше результата аналогичного периода прошлого года. **Gruppo Industriale Mediterraneo S.p.A.**

Milano, 15 ottobre 2024

## Sintesi dei Risultati del Terzo Trimestre

Il Consiglio di Amministrazione di Gruppo Industriale Mediterraneo S.p.A. (GIM) ha approvato oggi i risultati consolidati per il terzo trimestre dell'esercizio fiscale 2024, chiuso al 30 settembre 2024.

### Andamento Economico-Finanziario

Il Gruppo ha registrato una performance solida nel terzo trimestre, con ricavi totali pari a €487,3 milioni, in crescita del 12,4% rispetto allo stesso periodo dell'anno precedente. L'EBITDA adjusted si è attestato a €94,6 milioni, con un margine del 19,4%.

La divisione Automotive ha contribuito significativamente ai risultati, generando €312,8 milioni di fatturato, mentre il settore Componenti Industriali ha raggiunto €174,5 milioni. L'utile operativo (EBIT) del trimestre è stato di €68,2 milioni, rappresentando un incremento del 15,7% su base annua.

## Dati Finanziari Consolidati

| Periodo | Ricavi (€ mln) | Utile Operativo (€ mln) | Utile Netto (€ mln) |
|---------|----------------|-------------------------|---------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 445,7 | 61,3 | 42,8 |
| Q2 2024 | 468,2 | 64,9 | 45,1 |
| Q3 2024 | 487,3 | 68,2 | 48,6 |

### Posizione Finanziaria Netta

Al 30 settembre 2024, la posizione finanziaria netta del Gruppo risulta positiva per €156,4 milioni, migliorata rispetto ai €142,7 milioni del trimestre precedente. Il flusso di cassa operativo ha raggiunto €73,5 milioni nel Q3.

### Prospettive

L'Amministratore Delegato, Dott. Marco Santini, ha dichiarato: "I risultati del terzo trimestre confermano la solidità del nostro modello di business. Prevediamo di chiudere l'anno fiscale 2024 con ricavi consolidati superiori a €1,9 miliardi e un utile netto nell'ordine di €185 milioni."

Il Gruppo conferma gli investimenti pianificati per €95 milioni nel 2024, focalizzati su innovazione tecnologica e sostenibilità ambientale.

# Laporan Keuangan Kuartal III 2023
## PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia

**Jakarta, 15 Oktober 2023** - PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia (MSTI) mengumumkan hasil kinerja keuangan untuk kuartal ketiga tahun 2023 yang menunjukkan pertumbuhan signifikan di semua lini bisnis.

### Ringkasan Kinerja Keuangan

Perusahaan mencatat pendapatan konsolidasi sebesar Rp 2,45 triliun pada Q3 2023, meningkat 18,5% dibandingkan kuartal sebelumnya. Pertumbuhan ini didorong oleh ekspansi layanan cloud computing dan solusi digital untuk sektor perbankan dan ritel.

Laba operasional mencapai Rp 687 miliar, naik 22,3% dari Q2 2023, mencerminkan efisiensi operasional yang lebih baik dan margin keuntungan yang meningkat. Laba bersih perusahaan tercatat Rp 512 miliar, tumbuh 19,8% secara quarter-on-quarter.

### Tabel Kinerja Keuangan Tiga Kuartal Terakhir

| Indikator | Q1 2023 | Q2 2023 | Q3 2023 |
|-----------|---------|---------|---------|
| **Pendapatan (Rp Miliar)** | 1.856 | 2.067 | 2.450 |
| **Laba Operasional (Rp Miliar)** | 498 | 562 | 687 |
| **Laba Bersih (Rp Miliar)** | 371 | 427 | 512 |
| **Margin Laba Operasional (%)** | 26,8 | 27,2 | 28,0 |
| **Margin Laba Bersih (%)** | 20,0 | 20,7 | 20,9 |

### Analisis Segmen Bisnis

Divisi Cloud & Infrastructure Services menyumbang 58% dari total pendapatan dengan nilai Rp 1,42 triliun. Sementara itu, segmen Digital Solutions mencatatkan pertumbuhan tertinggi sebesar 35% YoY dengan pendapatan Rp 735 miliar.

Direktur Utama MSTI, Bapak Andrian Wijaya, menyatakan: "Kinerja Q3 2023 mencerminkan komitmen kami dalam memberikan solusi teknologi terdepan. Kami optimis dapat mempertahankan momentum pertumbuhan ini hingga akhir tahun dengan target pendapatan tahunan mencapai Rp 9,2 triliun."

### Proyeksi dan Outlook

Manajemen memproyeksikan pertumbuhan pendapatan sebesar 15-20% untuk Q4 2023, didukung oleh pipeline proyek senilai Rp 3,1 triliun dan ekspansi ke 12 kota baru di Indonesia.

# Q3 2023 Financial Report
## PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia

**Jakarta, October 15, 2023** - PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia (MSTI) announces its financial performance results for the third quarter of 2023, showing significant growth across all business lines.

### Financial Performance Summary

The Company recorded consolidated revenue of Rp 2.45 trillion in Q3 2023, an increase of 18.5% compared to the previous quarter. This growth was driven by the expansion of cloud computing services and digital solutions for the banking and retail sectors.

Operating profit reached Rp 687 billion, up 22.3% from Q2 2023, reflecting improved operational efficiency and increased profit margins. The Company's net profit was recorded at Rp 512 billion, growing 19.8% on a quarter-on-quarter basis.

### Financial Performance Table for the Last Three Quarters

| Indicator | Q1 2023 | Q2 2023 | Q3 2023 |
|-----------|---------|---------|---------|
| **Revenue (Rp Billion)** | 1,856 | 2,067 | 2,450 |
| **Operating Profit (Rp Billion)** | 498 | 562 | 687 |
| **Net Profit (Rp Billion)** | 371 | 427 | 512 |
| **Operating Profit Margin (%)** | 26.8 | 27.2 | 28.0 |
| **Net Profit Margin (%)** | 20.0 | 20.7 | 20.9 |

### Business Segment Analysis

The Cloud & Infrastructure Services division contributed 58% of total revenue with a value of Rp 1.42 trillion. Meanwhile, the Digital Solutions segment recorded the highest growth of 35% YoY with revenue of Rp 735 billion.

MSTI's President Director, Mr. Andrian Wijaya, stated: "Q3 2023 performance reflects our commitment to delivering cutting-edge technology solutions. We are optimistic about maintaining this growth momentum through year-end with an annual revenue target of Rp 9.2 trillion."

### Projections and Outlook

Management projects revenue growth of 15-20% for Q4 2023, supported by a project pipeline worth Rp 3.1 trillion and expansion into 12 new cities in Indonesia.

**บริษัท สยามเทคโนโลยี จำกัด (มหาชน)**

วันที่ 15 พฤศจิกายน 2567

## สรุปผลการดำเนินงาน

บริษัท สยามเทคโนโลジี จำกัด (มหาชน) ขอรายงานผลการดำเนินงานประจำไตรมาสที่ 3 ปี 2567 (กรกฎาคม - กันยายน 2567) โดยบริษัทมีรายได้รวม 2,847 ล้านบาท เพิ่มขึ้น 12.3% เมื่อเทียบกับไตรมาสเดียวกันของปีก่อน ซึ่งเป็นผลมาจากการขยายตัวของธุรกิจโซลูชันคลาวด์และบริการดิจิทัลทรานส์ฟอร์เมชัน

กำไรสุทธิในไตรมาสนี้อยู่ที่ 387 ล้านบาท เพิ่มขึ้น 18.5% จากไตรมาสที่แล้ว โดยมีอัตรากำไรสุทธิ 13.6% ซึ่งสูงกว่าเป้าหมายที่บริษัทตั้งไว้ที่ 12%

## ตารางสรุปผลการดำเนินงาน 3 ไตรมาสล่าสุด

| รายการ | Q1/2567 | Q2/2567 | Q3/2567 |
|--------|---------|---------|---------|
| รายได้จากการขาย (ล้านบาท) | 2,456 | 2,634 | 2,847 |
| กำไรจากการดำเนินงาน (ล้านบาท) | 412 | 445 | 498 |
| กำไรสุทธิ (ล้านบาท) | 298 | 327 | 387 |
| อัตรากำไรสุทธิ (%) | 12.1 | 12.4 | 13.6 |

## ไฮไลท์ทางธุรกิจ

ในไตรมาสที่ 3 บริษัทได้ลงนามสัญญาใหม่มูลค่ารวม 1,245 ล้านบาท โดยเฉพาะโครงการกับธนาคารกรุงศรีอยุธยา จำกัด (มหาชน) มูลค่า 450 ล้านบาท และบริษัท ปตท. จำกัด (มหาชน) มูลค่า 380 ล้านบาท

ค่าใช้จ่ายในการดำเนินงานอยู่ที่ 2,349 ล้านบาท คิดเป็น 82.5% ของรายได้ ลดลงจาก 84.2% ในไตรมาสที่แล้ว สะท้อนถึงประสิทธิภาพในการบริหารต้นทุนที่ดีขึ้น

## แนวโน้มและคาดการณ์

คณะกรรมการบริษัทมีมติอนุมัติจ่ายเงินปันผลระหว่างกาลในอัตรหุ้นละ 0.45 บาท รวมเป็นเงิน 225 ล้านบาท กำหนดจ่ายวันที่ 20 ธันวาคม 2567 สำหรับไตรมาสที่ 4 บริษัทคาดว่ารายได้จะเติบโตต่อเนื่องที่ระดับ 10-15% จากการขยายฐานลูกค้าในกลุ่มอุตสาหกรรมการผลิตและค้าปลีก

# Q3 2024 Operating Results Report

**Siam Technology Public Company Limited**

November 15, 2024

## Operating Results Summary

Siam Technology Public Company Limited reports its operating results for Q3 2024 (July - September 2024). The Company recorded total revenue of 2,847 million baht, an increase of 12.3% compared to the same quarter of the previous year, resulting from the expansion of cloud solution business and digital transformation services.

Net profit for this quarter was 387 million baht, an increase of 18.5% from the previous quarter, with a net profit margin of 13.6%, which exceeded the Company's target of 12%.

## Summary Table of Operating Results for the Last 3 Quarters

| Item | Q1/2024 | Q2/2024 | Q3/2024 |
|--------|---------|---------|---------|
| Sales Revenue (Million Baht) | 2,456 | 2,634 | 2,847 |
| Operating Profit (Million Baht) | 412 | 445 | 498 |
| Net Profit (Million Baht) | 298 | 327 | 387 |
| Net Profit Margin (%) | 12.1 | 12.4 | 13.6 |

## Business Highlights

In Q3, the Company signed new contracts totaling 1,245 million baht, particularly a project with Bank of Ayudhya Public Company Limited valued at 450 million baht and PTT Public Company Limited valued at 380 million baht.

Operating expenses were 2,349 million baht, representing 82.5% of revenue, down from 84.2% in the previous quarter, reflecting improved cost management efficiency.

## Outlook and Forecast

The Board of Directors has approved an interim dividend payment at the rate of 0.45 baht per share, totaling 225 million baht, with payment scheduled for December 20, 2024. For Q4, the Company expects revenue to continue growing at a level of 10-15% from expanding the customer base in the manufacturing and retail industry sectors.

4.3 คะแนนสามารถแลกรับของรางวัลได้ตามเงื่อนไขที่บริษัทกำหนด

## ข้อมูลทั่วไป

**ชื่อกองทุน:** กองทุนรวมหุ้นระยะยาว กรุงเทพแคปปิตอล อิควิตี้ กรอว์ธ ฟันด์ (BKK-LTF)

**การลงทุนในกองทุนรวมมิใช่การฝากเงิน** ผู้ลงทุนอาจได้รับเงินลงทุนคืนมากกว่าหรือน้อยกว่าเงินลงทุนเริ่มแรกก็ได้ ผลการดำเนินงานในอดีตมิได้เป็นสิ่งยืนยันถึงผลการดำเนินงานในอนาคต กองทุนนี้เหมาะสำหรับผู้ลงทุนที่ยอมรับความเสี่ยงในระดับสูงและมีระยะเวลาการลงทุนอย่างน้อย 5 ปี ผู้ลงทุนควรศึกษาข้อมูลในหนังสือชี้ชวนให้เข้าใจก่อนตัดสินใจลงทุน บริษัทจัดการขอสงวนสิทธิ์ในการเปลี่ยนแปลงเงื่อนไขตามที่ระบุในโครงการ

**บริษัท สยามเทคโนโลยี จำกัด (มหาชน)**

วันที่ 15 พฤศจิกายน 2567

## สรุปผลการดำเนินงาน

บริษัท สยามเทคโนโลジี จำกัด (มหาชน) ขอรายงานผลการดำเนินงานประจำไตรมาสที่ 3 ปี 2567 (กรกฎาคม - กันยายน 2567) โดยบริษัทมีรายได้รวม 2,847 ล้านบาท เพิ่มขึ้น 12.3% เมื่อเทียบกับไตรมาสเดียวกันของปีก่อน ซึ่งเป็นผลมาจากการขยายตัวของธุรกิจโซลูชันคลาวด์และบริการดิจิทัลทรานส์ฟอร์เมชัน

กำไรสุทธิในไตรมาสนี้อยู่ที่ 387 ล้านบาท เพิ่มขึ้น 18.5% จากไตรมาสที่ 2 ปี 2567 โดยมีอัตรากำไรสุทธิที่ 13.6% ซึ่งสูงกว่าเป้าหมายที่บริษัทตั้งไว้ที่ 12%

## ตารางสรุปผลการดำเนินงาน 3 ไตรมาสล่าสุด

| รายการ | Q1/2567 | Q2/2567 | Q3/2567 |
|--------|---------|---------|---------|
| รายได้จากการขาย (ล้านบาท) | 2,456 | 2,683 | 2,847 |
| กำไรจากการดำเนินงาน (ล้านบาท) | 412 | 445 | 498 |
| กำไรสุทธิ (ล้านบาท) | 298 | 327 | 387 |
| อัตรากำไรสุทธิ (%) | 12.1% | 12.2% | 13.6% |

## ปัจจัยสำคัญที่ส่งผลต่อผลการดำเนินงาน

1. **รายได้จากธุรกิจหลัก**: รายได้จากการให้บริการโซลูชันคลาวด์เพิ่มขึ้น 856 ล้านบาท คิดเป็น 30.1% ของรายได้รวม

2. **ต้นทุนและค่าใช้จ่าย**: บริษัทสามารถควบคุมต้นทุนการขายและบริหารได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ โดยลดลง 3.2% จากไตรมาสก่อน

3. **การลงทุนในนวัตกรรม**: บริษัทได้ลงทุนในการพัฒนาผลิตภัณฑ์ AI และ Machine Learning จำนวน 145 ล้านบาท

## แนวโน้มไตรมาสที่ 4 ปี 2567

คาดว่ารายได้ในไตรมาสที่ 4 จะอยู่ที่ประมาณ 3,100-3,250 ล้านบาท เนื่องจากเป็นช่วงไฮซีซันของธุรกิจ และมีโครงการใหม่จากภาครัฐและเอกชนมูลค่ารวม 1,200 ล้านบาท ที่จะเริ่มบันทึกรายได้ในไตรมาสนี้

# Q3 2024 Operating Results Report

**Siam Technology Public Company Limited**

November 15, 2024

## Operating Results Summary

Siam Technology Public Company Limited reports its operating results for Q3 2024 (July - September 2024). The Company recorded total revenue of 2,847 million baht, an increase of 12.3% compared to the same quarter of the previous year, resulting from the expansion of cloud solution business and digital transformation services.

Net profit for this quarter was 387 million baht, an increase of 18.5% from Q2 2024, with a net profit margin of 13.6%, which exceeded the Company's target of 12%.

## Summary Table of Operating Results for the Last 3 Quarters

| Item | Q1/2024 | Q2/2024 | Q3/2024 |
|--------|---------|---------|---------|
| Sales Revenue (Million Baht) | 2,456 | 2,683 | 2,847 |
| Operating Profit (Million Baht) | 412 | 445 | 498 |
| Net Profit (Million Baht) | 298 | 327 | 387 |
| Net Profit Margin (%) | 12.1% | 12.2% | 13.6% |

## Key Factors Affecting Operating Results

1. **Core Business Revenue**: Revenue from cloud solution services increased by 856 million baht, representing 30.1% of total revenue.

2. **Costs and Expenses**: The Company was able to efficiently control selling and administrative expenses, which decreased by 3.2% from the previous quarter.

3. **Investment in Innovation**: The Company invested 145 million baht in the development of AI and Machine Learning products.

## Q4 2024 Outlook

Revenue in Q4 is expected to be approximately 3,100-3,250 million baht due to the high season for the business, with new projects from government and private sectors totaling 1,200 million baht that will begin revenue recognition in this quarter.

# Q3 2024 Operating Results Report

**Siam Technology Public Company Limited**

November 15, 2024

## Operating Results Summary

Siam Technology Public Company Limited reports its operating results for Q3 2024 (July - September 2024). The Company recorded total revenue of 2,847 million baht, an increase of 12.3% compared to the same quarter of the previous year, resulting from the expansion of cloud solution business and digital transformation services.

Net profit for this quarter was 387 million baht, an increase of 18.5% from Q2 2024, with a net profit margin of 13.6%, which exceeded the Company's target of 12%.

## Summary Table of Operating Results for the Last 3 Quarters

| Item | Q1/2024 | Q2/2024 | Q3/2024 |
|--------|---------|---------|---------|
| Sales Revenue (Million Baht) | 2,456 | 2,683 | 2,847 |
| Operating Profit (Million Baht) | 298 | 342 | 401 |
| Net Profit (Million Baht) | 245 | 327 | 387 |
| Net Profit Margin (%) | 10.0% | 12.2% | 13.6% |

## Operating Results Analysis

In Q3, the Company received new orders totaling 3,200 million baht, particularly from government projects and large corporate clients in the manufacturing and financial sectors. Selling and administrative expenses were 456 million baht, representing 16.0% of revenue, down from 17.2% in the previous quarter.

The Company had cash and cash equivalents at the end of the quarter of 1,847 million baht and total liabilities of 2,134 million baht, resulting in a debt-to-equity ratio (D/E Ratio) of 0.42 times.

## Outlook and Forecast

The Company's Board of Directors forecasts that revenue in Q4 2024 will be approximately 3,100 million baht due to the high season for the business and new projects scheduled for delivery in December 2024.

| الربع الثاني 2023 | 923.2 | 178.9 | 134.5 |
| الربع الثالث 2023 | 1,045.7 | 215.4 | 167.2 |

### التحليل والتعليق

ارتفعت إيرادات الربع الثالث بنسبة 13.3% مقارنة بالربع الثاني، لتصل إلى 1,045.7 مليون ريال سعودي. ويعزى هذا النمو إلى:

- **زيادة حجم المبيعات:** ارتفع حجم المبيعات بنسبة 18% نتيجة توسع قاعدة العملاء في دول مجلس التعاون الخليجي
- **تحسن هوامش الربح:** بلغ هامش الربح التشغيلي 20.6% مقارنة بـ 19.4% في الربع السابق
- **كفاءة التشغيل:** انخفضت التكاليف التشغيلية بنسبة 7% بفضل برامج التحسين المستمر

### المركز المالي

بلغ إجمالي الأصول 4.8 مليار ريال سعودي في نهاية الربع الثالث، بينما وصل حقوق المساهمين إلى 2.3 مليار ريال. حافظت الشركة على نسبة سيولة قوية عند 1.8، مما يعكس قدرتها على الوفاء بالتزاماتها قصيرة الأجل.

### التوقعات المستقبلية

تتوقع الإدارة استمرار النمو في الربع الرابع من عام 2023، مع إيرادات متوقعة تتراوح بين 1,100 و 1,150 مليون ريال سعودي. كما تخطط الشركة لاستثمار 350 مليون ريال في توسعة المصنع الرئيسي بمدينة الجبيل الصناعية خلال عام 2024.

## Gulf Chemical Industries Company (PJSC)

Gulf Chemical Industries Company is pleased to announce its financial results for the third quarter of 2023. The Company achieved strong performance during this period, driven by increased demand for its core products in the Middle East and North Africa markets.

## أهداف الصندوق الاستثماري

يهدف صندوق الخليج المتوازن إلى تحقيق نمو رأسمالي طويل الأجل مع توليد دخل منتظم من خلال الاستثمار في محفظة متنوعة من الأسهم والسندات في أسواق دول مجلس التعاون الخليجي. يستثمر الصندوق 60% من أصوله في الأسهم المدرجة في أسواق الإمارات والسعودية والكويت، و40% في السندات الحكومية والشركات ذات التصنيف الائتماني العالي.

## إفصاح المخاطر

**تحذير هام:** الاستثمار في هذا الصندوق ينطوي على مخاطر مالية كبيرة. قد تنخفض قيمة استثماراتك وقد لا تسترد المبلغ الأصلي المستثمر. الأداء السابق لا يشكل ضماناً للعوائد المستقبلية. يتعرض الصندوق لمخاطر السوق، مخاطر أسعار الفائدة، مخاطر السيولة، والمخاطر الجيوسياسية في منطقة الخليج. يجب على المستثمرين قراءة نشرة الإصدار الكاملة قبل اتخاذ قرار الاستثمار. هذا الصندوق مناسب للمستثمرين ذوي القدرة المتوسطة إلى العالية على تحمل المخاطر وأفق استثماري لا يقل عن 5 سنوات.

بلغت التكاليف التشغيلية **669.2 مليون درهم**، بانخفاض نسبي قدره 3.2% من إجمالي الإيرادات مقارنة بالربع الثاني.

# TürkTech Holding A.Ş. 2024 Üçüncü Çeyrek Finansal Sonuçları

**İstanbul, 15 Ekim 2024** - TürkTech Holding A.Ş. (BIST: TTECH), 2024 yılının üçüncü çeyreğine ilişkin konsolide finansal sonuçlarını açıkladı.

## Finansal Performans Özeti

Şirketimiz, 2024 yılının üçüncü çeyreğinde güçlü büyüme ivmesini sürdürerek toplam 2,8 milyar TL konsolide net satış hasılatı elde etmiştir. Bu rakam, geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre %34,5 oranında artış göstermektedir.

### Çeyreksel Finansal Göstergeler

| Dönem | Net Satışlar (milyon TL) | Faaliyet Karı (milyon TL) | Net Dönem Karı (milyon TL) |
|-------|-------------------------|---------------------------|---------------------------|
| Ç1 2024 | 2.450 | 485 | 312 |
| Ç2 2024 | 2.620 | 512 | 338 |
| Ç3 2024 | 2.800 | 548 | 365 |

## Operasyonel Gelişmeler

Üçüncü çeyrekte faaliyet karımız 548 milyon TL'ye ulaşarak %19,6 faaliyet kar marjı gerçekleşmiştir. Net dönem karımız ise 365 milyon TL olarak kaydedilmiş olup, bu rakam bir önceki çeyreğe göre %8,0 artış göstermektedir.

Şirketimizin FAVÖK'ü (Faiz, Amortisman ve Vergi Öncesi Kar) 685 milyon TL seviyesinde gerçekleşerek, FAVÖK marjımız %24,5'e yükselmiştir. Bu performans, operasyonel verimliliğimizdeki sürekli iyileşmenin bir göstergesidir.

## Bilanço Yapısı

30 Eylül 2024 itibarıyla toplam varlıklarımız 8,5 milyar TL'ye, özsermayemiz ise 4,2 milyar TL'ye ulaşmıştır. Net finansal borç/FAVÖK oranımız 1,8x seviyesinde bulunmaktadır.

## Gelecek Dönem Beklentileri

Yönetim Kurulumuz, 2024 yılı sonunda toplam net satışların 11,2 milyar TL'yi aşmasını ve net kar marjının %13 seviyesinde gerçekleşmesini öngörmektedir. Dijital dönüşüm yatırımlarımız ve yeni ürün lansmanlarımız ile pazar payımızı artırmayı hedefliyoruz.

# TürkTech Holding A.Ş. 2024 Third Quarter Financial Results

**Istanbul, October 15, 2024** - TürkTech Holding A.Ş. (BIST: TTECH) announced its consolidated financial results for the third quarter of 2024.

## Financial Performance Summary

Our company achieved total consolidated net sales revenue of TL 2.8 billion in the third quarter of 2024, maintaining strong growth momentum. This figure represents an increase of 34.5% compared to the same period last year.

## Operational Developments

In the third quarter, our operating profit reached TL 548 million, achieving an operating profit margin of 19.6%. Our net profit for the period was recorded at TL 365 million, representing an increase of 8.0% compared to the previous quarter.

Our company's EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, Depreciation and Tax) was realized at the level of TL 685 million, with our EBITDA margin rising to 24.5%. This performance is an indicator of the continuous improvement in our operational efficiency.

As of September 30, 2024, our total assets reached TL 8.5 billion and our equity reached TL 4.2 billion. Our net financial debt/EBITDA ratio stands at 1.8x.

Our Board of Directors forecasts that total net sales will exceed TL 11.2 billion at the end of 2024 and that the net profit margin will be realized at the level of 13%. We aim to increase our market share through our digital transformation investments and new product launches.

The cardholder is obligated to pay at least the minimum payment amount (30% of the total debt or TL 500, whichever is higher) by the payment due date from the statement date. The statement date is the 15th of each month, and the payment due date is the 5th of the month.

Either party may terminate the agreement by providing 30 days' prior written notice. Upon termination, all debts shall become immediately due and payable.
